title: J004: Add systemd E2E test with Docker validation
description:
**Size:** 📦 medium
**Category:** testing
**Priority:** high
**Source:** Proposed for 'After binary builds, Docker image builds, etc. are now in place'

Create systemd E2E test that validates the plexd.service unit file works correctly. Build test/e2e/systemd/Dockerfile as a systemd-enabled container (ubuntu base with systemd init). Create test/e2e/systemd/test.sh orchestration script that: starts the systemd container and mock-api container on the same Docker network, copies the plexd binary and deploy/systemd/plexd.service unit file into the systemd container, configures PLEXD_API_URL via environment drop-in file, runs systemctl start plexd, polls /test/assertions on mock-api to validate registration + heartbeat + metadata counters, then runs systemctl stop plexd and verifies clean shutdown. Add Makefile target test-e2e-systemd.

**Rationale:** systemd is the deployment mode for bare-metal and VM installations. Without E2E testing, unit file syntax errors, incorrect ExecStart paths, missing environment configuration, or service dependency issues would only surface during manual deployment. Validates the full service lifecycle.

**Affected Areas:**
- test/e2e/systemd/Dockerfile
- test/e2e/systemd/test.sh
- deploy/systemd/plexd.service
- Makefile

stories.so_that: unit file syntax errors, ExecStart path mismatches, environment configuration issues, and service dependency problems are caught before deployment
criteria: test/e2e/systemd/Dockerfile builds a systemd-enabled Ubuntu container with systemd as PID 1
test/e2e/systemd/test.sh orchestrates the full test lifecycle: container setup, service start, assertion polling, clean shutdown
The test validates that plexd registers with the mock API (registration_count >= 1)
The test validates that plexd sends heartbeats (heartbeat_count >= 1)
The test validates that plexd fetches metadata (metadata_count >= 1)
The Makefile target test-e2e-systemd runs the complete test as a self-contained operation

requirements.description: The test SHALL poll GET /test/assertions on mock-api and verify registration_count >= 1, heartbeat_count >= 1, and metadata_count >= 1

tasks: [done] 1.1 Create test/e2e/systemd/Dockerfile — Ubuntu-based systemd container (REQ-001). Use ubuntu:24.04 as base. Install systemd, curl, and jq. Set systemd as init (CMD ["/sbin/init"]). Create directories /etc/plexd (0755), /var/lib/plexd (0700), /var/run/plexd (0755). Remove unnecessary systemd units to speed up boot. Set STOPSIGNAL SIGRTMIN+3 for clean systemd shutdown. Verified by: docker build succeeds, container starts with systemd as PID 1.

[done] 1.2 Create test/e2e/systemd/test.sh — orchestration script skeleton with cleanup trap (REQ-002, REQ-008). POSIX shell script with set -euo pipefail. Define constants: NETWORK_NAME=plexd-e2e-systemd, MOCKAPI_CONTAINER=mockapi-systemd, SYSTEMD_CONTAINER=plexd-systemd, POLL_TIMEOUT=60, POLL_INTERVAL=2. Implement cleanup() function that stops/removes containers and removes the Docker network. Register cleanup in trap for EXIT. Implement log() helper that prints timestamped messages to stderr. Script structure: create_network, start_mockapi, start_systemd_container, install_plexd, start_service, poll_assertions, verify_shutdown, cleanup.

[done] 1.3 Implement test.sh: network creation and mock-api container startup (REQ-002, REQ-004). Create Docker network with docker network create $NETWORK_NAME. Start mock-api container: docker run -d --name $MOCKAPI_CONTAINER --network $NETWORK_NAME mockapi:latest -addr :8080. Wait for mock-api health: poll GET http://localhost mapped port or use docker exec to curl /v1/ping. Fail if mock-api doesn't start within 15 seconds.

[done] 1.4 Implement test.sh: systemd container startup and plexd installation (REQ-002, REQ-003, REQ-007, REQ-009). Start systemd container with: docker run -d --name $SYSTEMD_CONTAINER --network $NETWORK_NAME --privileged --cgroupns=host -v /sys/fs/cgroup:/sys/fs/cgroup:rw --tmpfs /run --tmpfs /run/lock <systemd-image>. Wait for systemd to be ready: poll 'docker exec $SYSTEMD_CONTAINER systemctl is-system-running' until 'running' or 'degraded'. Copy plexd binary: docker cp ./plexd $SYSTEMD_CONTAINER:/usr/local/bin/plexd && docker exec chmod 755. Copy unit file: docker cp deploy/systemd/plexd.service $SYSTEMD_CONTAINER:/etc/systemd/system/plexd.service. Write config.yaml via docker exec with correct API URL (http://$MOCKAPI_CONTAINER:8080) and required fields. Write bootstrap token. Run systemctl daemon-reload.

[done] 1.5 Implement test.sh: service start and assertion polling loop (REQ-003, REQ-004). Run docker exec $SYSTEMD_CONTAINER systemctl start plexd. Verify is-active returns 'active'. Implement polling loop: every $POLL_INTERVAL seconds, curl http://$MOCKAPI_CONTAINER:8080/test/assertions from inside the systemd container (or from the host via port mapping on mock-api). Parse JSON response with jq. Check registration_count >= 1 AND heartbeat_count >= 1 AND metadata_count >= 1. If all satisfied, break and continue to shutdown. If timeout expires, print last assertions, journalctl output, exit 1.

[done] 1.6 Implement test.sh: clean shutdown verification (REQ-005). Run docker exec $SYSTEMD_CONTAINER systemctl stop plexd. Verify is-active returns 'inactive'. Check journalctl -u plexd for absence of crash indicators: grep for 'core dumped', 'segfault', 'SIGABRT', 'SIGKILL'. If any crash indicators found, print diagnostic output and exit 1. Print success message.

[done] 1.7 Implement test.sh: diagnostic output on failure (REQ-008). Create dump_diagnostics() function called on any failure. Captures and prints: docker exec journalctl -u plexd --no-pager -n 100, docker exec systemctl status plexd, curl mock-api /test/assertions (if reachable), docker logs of both containers. Called from the main flow on any non-zero exit or assertion timeout.

[done] 2.1 Add Makefile target test-e2e-systemd (REQ-006). Target depends on building plexd binary (CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux go build -o plexd-e2e-systemd ./cmd/plexd), building mock-api image (docker build -f test/e2e/mockapi/Dockerfile -t mockapi:latest .), building systemd image (docker build -f test/e2e/systemd/Dockerfile -t plexd-systemd:latest .), then executing bash test/e2e/systemd/test.sh. Add .PHONY declaration. Ensure the binary is built for linux/amd64 regardless of host OS.

[done] 3.1 Write docs/reference/backend/systemd-e2e-test.md — reference documentation (REQ-010). Document: purpose and scope, file structure (Dockerfile, test.sh, Makefile target), container architecture diagram, prerequisites (Docker), how to run locally (make test-e2e-systemd), assertion thresholds and timeout values, troubleshooting common failures (systemd won't start, assertion timeout, container startup issues). Follow existing docs/reference/backend/ file conventions.

implementation_notes:
Architecture: Two Docker containers on a shared bridge network. Container 1: mock-api (distroless, runs the Go mock server on :8080). Container 2: Ubuntu 24.04 with systemd as PID 1, running in --privileged mode with cgroup access for full systemd functionality.

Key design decisions:
- Ubuntu 24.04 base for the systemd container (not Alpine) because systemd requires glibc and a full init system
- --privileged flag required for systemd cgroup management inside Docker
- --cgroupns=host and -v /sys/fs/cgroup:/sys/fs/cgroup:rw for cgroup v2 support
- STOPSIGNAL SIGRTMIN+3 for clean systemd container shutdown
- Config.yaml is written directly (not via plexd install) to avoid needing the installer flow — the test validates the unit file and service lifecycle, not the installer
- The plexd binary is cross-compiled with CGO_ENABLED=0 for the test (static binary that works in Ubuntu container)
- Bootstrap token 'e2e-test-token' is used (mock API accepts any token)
- The API URL uses the Docker container hostname: http://mockapi-systemd:8080
- The config.yaml must use the correct YAML structure that AgentConfig.ParseConfig expects: nested api.base_url field
- The EnvironmentFile /etc/plexd/environment is optional (dash prefix in unit file) — not needed for this test since config.yaml provides the API URL

Potential pitfalls:
- systemd inside Docker requires specific cgroup configuration; test on both cgroup v1 and v2 hosts
- The systemd container must wait for systemd to fully initialize before running systemctl commands
- plexd's ExecStart path must match exactly: /usr/local/bin/plexd up --config /etc/plexd/config.yaml
- The plexd binary needs NET_ADMIN capabilities (provided by ProtectSystem/AmbientCapabilities in unit file + --privileged container)
- Poll from the host or from inside the systemd container — using docker exec curl is simpler than port mapping

Existing patterns followed:
- test/e2e/mockapi/ — existing mock API server and Dockerfile
- deploy/systemd/plexd.service — existing production unit file
- deploy/docker/Dockerfile — existing plexd Docker image build pattern
- Makefile — existing targets: docker-build, test, test-e2e
- docs/reference/backend/ — existing reference documentation pattern
